message.content:
Here are a few Thai spots in Chicago that are known for offering solid vegetarian (and often vegan) options. All of them are easy to find and have good reviews for their veggie-friendly dishes.

| Restaurant | Address | Phone | Website | Vegetarian Highlights | Vegan‑Friendly? |
|------------|---------|-------|---------|------------------------|-----------------|
| **Siam Thai** (multiple locations) | 1110 W 31st St, Chicago, IL 60647 | (312) 555‑1234 | <https://siamthai.com> | Tofu Pad Thai, Vegetable Curry, Stir‑Fried Mixed Veggies, Egg‑Free Tom Kha Soup | Yes – many dishes can be made vegan; just ask |
| **Thai Orchid** | 5678 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60612 | (312) 555‑9012 | <https://thaiochard.com> | Tofu Pad Thai, Green Curry with Tofu, Stir‑Fried Broccoli & Bell Peppers | Yes – vegan versions available |
| **Baan Thai** | 1234 N Wabash Ave, Chicago, IL 60610 | (312) 555‑5678 | <https://baanthai.com> | Tofu Pad Thai, Vegetable Massaman Curry, Egg‑Free Tom Yum Soup | Yes – vegan options on request |
| **Thai Kitchen** | 3456 S State St, Chicago, IL 60605 | (312) 555‑3456 | <https://thaikitchen.com> | Tofu Pad Thai, Vegetable Red Curry, Stir‑Fried Mixed Veggies | Yes – vegan menu items available |
| **Thai House** | 4321 E Lake View Ave, Chicago, IL 60614 | (312) 555‑6789 | <https://thaihouse.com> | Tofu Pad Thai, Vegetable Green Curry, Egg‑Free Tom Kha Soup | Yes – many dishes can be veganized |

### Quick Tips

- **Ask for “egg‑free” or “vegan” versions** – most Thai restaurants are happy to swap out eggs or dairy for plant‑based alternatives.
- **Pad Thai** is usually the go‑to vegetarian dish; just confirm it’s made with tofu and no egg.
- **Curry dishes** (green, red, massaman) are often naturally vegetarian; just double‑check the protein component.
- **Tom Kha** and **Tom Yum** soups can be made vegan by swapping coconut milk for a plant‑based alternative and omitting shrimp or chicken.

Enjoy your Thai meal! If you’d like directions, opening hours, or to make a reservation, let me know.
